title_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Me Super Lokacion !!!
description_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Njesi Biznesi Me Super Lokacion!!! Ambienti ka siperfaqe 336m² nga te cilat 256m² eshte njesi biznesi dhe 80m² jane garazhet te cilat mund te perdoren per parkim ose furnizime te ndryshme. Ambienti eshte strukturuar ne tre dhoma dhe tre tualete. Ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati 11-katesh te mireadministruar dhe ka hyrje te dedikuar. Prona ka nje lokacion perfekt, orientim lindje-Perendim dhe rrethohet me biznese te ndryshme dhe me fluks levizjesh. Duke qene se prona eshte e pajisur me fasade xhami ofron mundesi shume te mire reklamimi te biznesit. Ambjenti ka shkallet me hyrje te vecuar si dhe fasade xhami me pamje nga rruga, ka hyrje nga te dyia anet e pallatit. Ambienti mund te shfrytezohet per aktivitete te tjera te ndryshme si: zyre avokatie, kontabiliteti apo noterie, market, pasi ndarjet jane te realizuara me gips dhe ka mundesi per tu pershtatur ne openspace.
title_en: In Astir, a business unit with a great location is for sale!!!
description_en: In Astir, a business unit with a super location is for sale!!! The area has a surface of 336m², of which 256m² is a business unit and 80m² are garages that can be used for parking or various supplies. The environment is structured in three rooms and three toilets. It is located on the 0th floor of a well-managed 11-story building and has a dedicated entrance. The property has a perfect location, east-west orientation and is surrounded by various businesses and a flow of traffic. Since the property is equipped with glass facades, it offers very good business advertising opportunities. The premises have stairs with a separate entrance as well as a glass facade overlooking the street, there are entrances from both sides of the building. The environment can be used for other different activities such as: law office, accounting or notary, market, since the partitions are made with plaster and it has the possibility to adapt to open space.
